# Moksha Sewa

Moksha Sewa helps families in India request dignified cremation assistance, ambulance or hearse van support, pandit guidance, ritual samagri, prayer hall coordination, volunteer care, and donation-backed sewa.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://mokshasewa.org/): Overview of Moksha Sewa and how it helps families
- [About Moksha Sewa](https://mokshasewa.org/about): Mission, trust and team behind Moksha Sewa
- [Request Cremation Assistance](https://mokshasewa.org/request-help): Submit a help request for last-rites support
- [Volunteer Registration](https://mokshasewa.org/volunteer/register): Register as a Moksha Sewa volunteer
- [Contact Support](https://mokshasewa.org/contact): Phone, email, WhatsApp and contact form
- [Blog and Ritual Guides](https://mokshasewa.org/blog): Articles and guides on rituals and last rites
- [Photo Gallery](https://mokshasewa.org/mokshagallery): Photos of sewa work
- [Video Gallery](https://mokshasewa.org/mokshavediogallery): Videos of sewa work
- [Donation Support](https://mokshasewa.org/donation): Support funeral and cremation assistance

## Main Actions

- Families can submit help requests at [/request-help](https://mokshasewa.org/request-help).
- Volunteers can register at [/volunteer/register](https://mokshasewa.org/volunteer/register).
- Donors can support funeral and cremation assistance at [/donation](https://mokshasewa.org/donation).
- Visitors can contact the team by phone, email, WhatsApp, or the contact form at [/contact](https://mokshasewa.org/contact).
